quests.desc: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First off, go east. With that accomplished, try to head south. With that accomplished, ensure that the gate is open. After you have pulled open the gate, take a trip west. And then, open the portal within the cookhouse. And then, make an effort to head west. Then, ensure that the gateway inside the lounge is open. After that, make an effort to move south. And then, make an effort to go east. Then, pick up the apple from the mantle inside the studio. And if you do that, you're the winner!

objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, make an effort to head east. With that over with, venture south. After that, open the gate within the laundry place. Then, attempt to go west. Next, open the portal. And then, try to move west. Following that, ensure that the gateway is open. And then, attempt to go to the south. With that accomplished, go to the east. And then, recover the apple from the mantle in the studio. Got that? Good!
